name: Smart Search's advanced form on a desktop (1366x900), as admin and as viewer2 (limited to every library but Movies 2). As admin it seeds synthetic metadata (genres, tags, a studio, ratings, dates, an original title, overviews, an IMDb id, a lock, a show's status; the same every run) and each user marks their own watch state on three movies. Keyboard only: Advanced, Add rule (Enter), the field and condition chosen with the arrow keys, From and To typed, a None-of group added with its rule, Enter searches; the results are what /Items finds. Then every field of the catalogue: a rule built in the editor's controls (the show picker's suggestion, chips typed, choices, libraries, yes or no, providers), searched, and its results compared with what core /Items gives the same user for the same rule (Path only as admin; viewer2's list never offers it). Inline checks: an empty value stops the search with the message under its rule. A saved advanced query opens again in the advanced form. Screenshots smartsearch-advanced-*.png. Needs a sandbox seeded by Initialize-Sandbox.ps1.
